concept.zh: 固定输入比较不同的门
concept.en: Compare different gates with the same inputs

brief.zh: 每次先预测灯会不会亮，再拨动 A、B 或换一个门。输入没变时，换门也可能改变结果。
brief.en: Predict whether the light will turn on, then flip A or B or select a different gate. A new gate can give a different result with the same inputs.

hints.zh: 试试让两路输入都为 1，再来回比较 OR 和 XOR。
hints.en: Set both inputs to 1, then switch between OR and XOR.

hints.zh: 试选 NOT，只拨右边几次，再拨左边一次。
hints.en: Select NOT. Flip the right switch a few times, then flip the left switch once.

label.zh: A 开、B 关，先用 AND
label.en: A on and B off, starting with AND
Both inputs on, starting with OR

label.zh: A 关、B 开，先用 NOT
label.en: A off and B on, starting with NOT
